 Greta Cross USA TODAY Oct. 21, 2026, 3:01 p.m. ET Hear this story After a rocky past season , Noah and Joanne are all ready to move in together.
 Netflix's hit romance series "Nobody Wants This" returns for its Season 3 premiere on Thursday, Oct. 22.
 After recommitting to each other at the end of Season 2, Noah (Adam Brody) and Joanne (Kristen Bell) are moving into a house together. The relationship feels solid as the two embrace exciting firsts that come with building a life together, according to Netflix's Tudum .
 "We didn’t have to do any more 'Will they, won’t they?' We know they are going to, and it was sort of, 'How are they going to?'" Co-showrunner and executive producer Jenni Jonner told Tudum.
 Here's what to know about the premiere of "Nobody Wants This" Season 3.
 Watch it here: Stream your favorite shows, the biggest blockbusters and more. When does 'Nobody Wants This' Season 3 premiere?
 All 10 episodes of "Nobody Wants This" Season 3 premiere on Thursday, Oct. 22.
 Watch the 'Nobody Wants This' Season 3 trailer
 Do you need a Netflix subscription to watch 'Nobody Wants This' Season 3?
 Yes, "Nobody Wants This" is only available for streaming on Netflix with a paid subscription.

 Andrew Rannells as Sebastien

 Poorna Jagannathan as Eleanor
